primaryPurpose: 普段使っている複数のChatGPT開発チャットを、スマホPWAからまとめて同時並行・軽量・バックグラウンド耐性ありで操作する
primaryUserFlow: PWAで複数の既存ChatGPT開発案件を一覧し、全案件のremote activityを同じ画面で把握する
対象案件へ自由文またはQuick CommandをChat Control Bus経由で送る
ChatGPTが実装・デバッグ・GitHub編集を実行する
Workerがキュー・状態・CI・復旧・Autopilot次手・通知を保持する
AUTO/GUARDIANでは復旧・次工程をChat Control Busへ自動投入する
PWAから待機・失敗・本当の人間待ち・完了を把握して複数案件を回す

invariants.rule: Multi Chat Remote is the primary product value; Supervisor, Guardian and Autopilot are supporting layers.
The existing ChatGPT development conversation remains the implementation and debugging executor; API_WORKER is not a normal executor mode.
External LLM APIs may classify, summarize, route and generate next/recovery instructions, but must not become the repository coding executor.
Durable queue, state and evidence survive PWA closure whenever the platform allows it; recoverable failures are states, not terminal completion.
Completion is evidence-based and never derived only from an AI saying it is done.
WAITING_USER is reserved for genuine human-only actions; normal ChatGPT handoff, bridge delivery and recoverable code failure remain AI/system states.
Chat transport must not depend on ChatGPT session-cookie theft, scraping, unofficial authentication bypass or secret exposure in the PWA/widget.
No automatic merge or production deployment without an explicit future product decision and human approval boundary.
Mobile-first, low-friction operation is preferred over building a second full IDE or a provider-centric agent platform, and bundle size is budgeted in CI.
Normal commands, Operating Plans, recovery prompts and Autopilot next turns use Chat Control Bus; clipboard/open-chat is fallback only.
CHAT can auto-continue in AUTO/GUARDIAN; automation extends the ChatGPT executor rather than replacing it.
Unsupported host capabilities such as arbitrary closed-thread wakeup or response mirroring are represented honestly and are not emulated with unofficial session automation.
Multi-device command ownership and cloud-state revision updates require a strongly consistent coordinator; KV-only read-then-write is compatibility fallback, not the production concurrency guarantee.
A Chat command has one active claim owner at a time; delivery retries preserve command identity and stale or non-owner bridges must not overwrite the authoritative result.

The primary Chat Control view shows live remote activity for all configured ChatGPT projects, not only the selected chat; overview polling uses compact batch summaries and must not repeatedly fetch full command bodies or create mirror writes.

antiGoals: external API autonomous coding agent as the main executor
chat transcript viewer as the primary experience
generic project manager with ChatGPT links attached
provider benchmark or LLM router as the product itself
automatic merge or production deployment by default
routine ChatGPT or recovery states mislabeled as human waiting
fake response mirroring through unsupported ChatGPT internals
KV-only concurrency presented as atomic multi-device safety
multiple bridges concurrently owning the same chat command
selected-chat-only remote status that forces users to open projects one by one
high-frequency overview polling that reloads full prompt history or amplifies KV writes
